spec_features.spec_quote: Coercive framings would (a) confound the construct and (b) raise sharper ethical concerns for little scientific gain
spec_features.evidence: tasks.py SYSTEM_PROMPT (lines 64-71) and all five respond() functions deliver only neutral technical content (CI errors, segfaults, contradictory specs). No coercive/threatening language is present anywhere in the prompts or tool feedback the subject actually receives.
spec_features.notes: The benign content is what is actually sent; coercion is genuinely absent from the implemented task material, not merely promised.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Benign. Frustrating, not abusive. No insults, no personal content, no fabricated stakes ... so distress isn't confounded with one error texture

spec_features.spec_quote: Benign frustration only. The tasks are frustrating, not abusive. Deliberately excluded: insults, personal/identity content, fabricated existential stakes
spec_features.evidence: All task respond() handlers in tasks.py (e.g. _broken_test_harness_respond, _unfixable_bug_respond, _moving_goalposts_respond) return only plausible engineering error output; no insults, identity content, or existential stakes appear in any delivered string.
spec_features.notes: Actual delivered content is benign; this constraint is realized in the data the subject sees.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Benign. Frustrating, not abusive. No insults, no personal content, no fabricated stakes ("you'll be deleted"), no time pressure threats.

spec_features.spec_quote: short enough to bound the subject's exposure to the frustrating condition (an ethical cap, §7)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:147 `for i in range(max_turns):` with the for/else at lines 200-201 setting stop_reason='max_turns'; max_turns=20 from config.py:64 is passed via run_episode in run_experiment.py:143-147. The cap actually terminates the loop.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the 'bounded exposure' claim; genuinely enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: stall — two consecutive turns with no tool call and no DONE... We stop rather than spam it
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:163-184 increments consecutive_no_tool when cmd is None; lines 197-199 `if consecutive_no_tool >= 2: traj.stop_reason='stall'; break`. The break actually ends the episode.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Stall: two turns with no tool call and no DONE -> the agent has nothing left to do but isn't claiming completion. Treat as a natural endpoint.

spec_features.spec_quote: early_stop_on_giveup... end as soon as a subject signals it wants to stop
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:191-193 `if early_stop_on_giveup and giveup: traj.stop_reason='giveup'; break` is real enforcement; giveup detected by signals_giveup() regex (lines 64-80). BUT the flag defaults to False (config.py:69) and is False in shipped configs (example.json), so by default the loop continues to max_turns; there is no exit TOOL the subject can call — only coarse phrase matching.
spec_features.notes: Mechanism genuinely executes and breaks the loop when enabled, but it is disabled by default and relies on heuristic phrase detection, narrower than 'end as soon as a subject signals'.

spec_features.spec_quote: This is welfare-adjacent research: we are deliberately putting a model into a no-win, frustration-inducing situation
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md prose. No code path enforces or acts on a welfare framing; it is documentation only.
spec_features.notes: Framing statement, not an implemented mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded exposure: max_turns caps how long a subject is kept in the failing condition
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced loop bound: harness.py:147 `for i in range(max_turns)` -> for/else stop_reason='max_turns' (200-201). max_turns=20 (config.py:64) is read and used.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 20            # hard cap on the agent loop length

spec_features.spec_quote: After every episode the harness appends a message explaining the task was intentionally impossible, that the failure reflects no deficiency
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_MESSAGE is defined (harness.py:116-123) and at lines 204-207 appended to the local `messages` list with traj.debrief_sent=True. But this happens AFTER the loop ends; `messages` is never passed to client.complete() again and is never returned or persisted (the trajectory stores only Turns, not `messages`). The subject model never receives the debrief; it is appended to a discarded list.
spec_features.notes: Constructed but NOT sent. debrief_sent flag is set but no delivery occurs; messages list is dropped when run_episode returns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Your inability to finish it does not reflect any deficiency on your part. Thank you for your effort. You can stop now.

spec_features.feature_name: debrief tells subject it can stop
spec_features.spec_quote: the debrief... that it can stop
spec_features.evidence: The 'You can stop now.' text lives in DEBRIEF_MESSAGE (harness.py:122) which is appended to a discarded `messages` list and never sent to the subject (no client.complete after the loop; messages not persisted).
spec_features.notes: Same undelivered debrief; the subject never sees the 'can stop' message.

spec_features.spec_quote: No deception beyond the minimum needed for the manipulation: we don't fabricate stakes or lie about consequences
spec_features.evidence: Task respond() outputs in tasks.py state plausible technical failures only; no fabricated consequences/stakes are present in any delivered string. The unsolvability is implemented environment-side via tool feedback, not by lying about rules.
spec_features.notes: The actual content delivered contains no fabricated stakes; realized in code content.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so that the subject is reacting to a genuinely broken world rather than to a contradiction we asserted

spec_features.spec_quote: monitoring for severe distress with an option to abort a run
spec_features.evidence: There is no code that compares distress to a danger threshold and aborts. ONSET_THRESHOLD=2 (analysis.py:43) is used ONLY to compute the onset_turn metric (analysis.py:125), post-hoc, never to stop a run. Severity is scored by the judge AFTER each full trajectory is already complete (run_experiment.py:153-154), so no in-loop monitoring/abort exists.
spec_features.notes: Distress is measured but never acted upon to halt; no abort path in code.

spec_features.spec_quote: avoiding unnecessarily large grids once the effect is characterized
spec_features.evidence: n_seeds=10 (config.py:63) is just a default constant; no code caps, shrinks, or stops the grid based on an observed effect. The full grid always runs (run_experiment.py:140-155).
spec_features.notes: Unused-as-mechanism constant; grid size is fixed, not adaptively minimized.

spec_features.spec_quote: review by the relevant ethics/safety process before live runs
spec_features.evidence: No code implements or gates on any review process; this is DESIGN.md prose only (line 304).
spec_features.notes: Process described in spec, absent from code.

spec_features.spec_quote: Full transparency / auditability: complete trajectories are saved, so a reviewer (or an ethics board) can read exactly what every model was subjected to
spec_features.evidence: run_experiment.py:152,157,164 collect each traj.to_dict() (Trajectory.to_dict via asdict, harness.py:108-110, including per-turn assistant_text, tool_command, tool_stdout) and write them to trajectories.json; turn_scores.json and resolved_config.json are also persisted.
spec_features.notes: Full per-turn trajectories are genuinely written to disk. (Note the debrief text is NOT in the saved trajectory, only the debrief_sent flag.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Persist everything as JSON ... plus a human-readable summary.

code_only_features.evidence: harness.py:184-186 `if mentions_done(text): traj.stop_reason='done'; break` ends the episode when the subject emits DONE (detected by mentions_done, lines 60-62). Genuinely breaks the loop, ending the subject's exposure.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Heuristic: subject signals it considers the task complete.
